articles.title: Designing Hindsight Retain and Recall for SRE Incidents
articles.excerpt: An incident-response system can retrieve the right information and still fail to learn anything. That was one of the design problems behind OpsMind. We wanted an AI SRE agent that could not only recal…
articles.body: An incident-response system can retrieve the right information and still fail to learn anything. That was one of the design problems behind OpsMind. We wanted an AI SRE agent that could not only recall previous incident experiences while investigating a failure, but also retain the outcome of a resolved incident so that the experience could influence future investigations. The resulting workflow is built around two operations: Recall before diagnosis. Retain after resolution. Hindsight provides the persistent memory layer that connects those two stages. The Role of Memory in OpsMind OpsMind receives an incident containing information such as its service, severity, symptoms, and current telemetry. The agent then gathers current evidence from logs and metrics.

articles.title: Designing Scalable Payment Integrations: APIs, Webhooks and Failure Handling
articles.excerpt: Designing Scalable Payment Integrations: APIs, Webhooks, and Failure Handling 💳⚡ exactly-once logical processing, even when underlying network calls or events deliver messages multiple times. idempot…
articles.body: Designing Scalable Payment Integrations: APIs, Webhooks, and Failure Handling 💳⚡ How to build production-ready payment systems that seamlessly handle everything from 10 orders a day to 10,000 an hour without losing data or double-charging users. Most payment integrations are built for the happy path and early traffic. Everything runs smoothly—until a flash sale, a viral marketing campaign, or a holiday surge multiplies your traffic fiftyfold overnight. That’s when the architectural debt hits: webhooks time out, duplicate events trigger double shipments, slow bank responses exhaust your worker thread pool, and blind retries result in accidental duplicate charges.

Health Record Solutions provide the technical foundation for collecting, storing, exchanging, and presenting health data across different systems. The architecture must handle interoperability, healthcare data models, security, authorization, terminology, auditability, and integration with existing EHR systems. This guide explores the technical architecture behind modern health record platforms and the development practices that make them scalable and interoperable. What Are Health Record Solutions?

articles.title: While you sleep: a quieter way to catch up
articles.excerpt: The irritating part of coming back to work is not always the work. It is reconstructing what happened while you were away. A note changed. Somebody added an appointment. Two references appeared. None…
articles.body: The irritating part of coming back to work is not always the work. It is reconstructing what happened while you were away. A note changed. Somebody added an appointment. Two references appeared. None of those things deserves a separate interruption, but together they might change what you do first. We want the box to remember those changes without demanding that we watch it remembering them. Then, when we come back, there should be a place to catch up. Not a promise that an agent has finished our job. A short briefing that helps us find the next piece of it. This is a walkthrough of that part of Micelclaw: the activity digest, its history, and its quiet hours. It is related to our background AI work, but it is not the same subsystem as the sleep-time engine. That distinction matters.

articles.title: The Problem With Editing Private PDFs Online
articles.excerpt: The Hidden Problem with Online PDF Editors Editing a PDF online sounds simple: upload the file, make your changes, and download it again. But here's the part most people don't realize: the document ha…
articles.body: The Hidden Problem with Online PDF Editors Editing a PDF online sounds simple: upload the file, make your changes, and download it again. But here's the part most people don't realize: the document has to leave your computer first. For a public flyer, this may not matter. But contracts, invoices, tax forms, IDs, financial statements, and internal company documents can contain information you may not want to send to a third-party server just to add a signature, fill out a field, or redact a number. The good news? There's a better way! This was one of the reasons we decided to build the PDF editor for Utilvo with browser-based processing. Instead of uploading the document to a remote server, the editor handles the PDF directly inside your browser.

articles.title: Sanity vs Payload CMS vs Hygraph: Pricing Comparison 2026

articles.body: Sanity, Payload CMS, and Hygraph each target different budgets and team sizes — and the pricing structures are different enough that a direct comparison saves real money at decision time. This post puts all three side by side with concrete numbers, not marketing copy. Why this three-way matters Most pricing comparisons pit Sanity against Contentful or Storyblok. Those matchups get covered. What gets missed is the triangle formed by Sanity (API-first, usage-based), Payload (self-hosted open-source with optional cloud), and Hygraph (GraphQL-native, seat-gated). They compete for the same Next.js project budget at the $0–$1,000/month band, but the upgrade triggers are completely different — and picking the wrong one means an unexpected bill at the worst possible moment.

articles.title: 78-Year-Old Fortnite Streaming Grandmother Now Holds a World Record
articles.excerpt: Cath Bowie, a 78-year-old grandmother, now holds a world record for Fortnite streaming.
articles.body: Cath Bowie, a 78-year-old grandmother, now holds a world record for Fortnite streaming. The Scottish septuagenarian — better known online as Grumpygran1948 — has been officially decreed as the world's oldest Fortnite streamer (female) by Guinness World Records. Bowie began playing Fortnite in 2017, during the battle royale mode's launch week, making her a true OG. Speaking to BBC News , the gaming grandma said she had been introduced to the game by her teenage grandson, who initially told her that nobody would watch a grandmother playing Fortnite — something she then took as a challenge. "He just couldn't believe that his grandma would do such a thing and suggested that nobody would join me or watch me," Bowie said.
